g.text: Debt-mechanic proxies do not predict the label, they contain it

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', 'Source Sans Pro', 'Lato', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #58585b

g.text: Left: ROC for predicting who holds debt, five-fold cross-validation. Right: standardised coefficients, honest model

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', 'Source Sans Pro', 'Lato', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #758d99

g.text: Source: synthitaly simulation — 800 consumers × 720 days, seed 42

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', 'Source Sans Pro', 'Lato', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #58585b

g.text: “Honest only” is the 34-column behavioural set; “plus proxies” adds the 10 debt-mechanic columns. Faint lines are the five individual folds;

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', 'Source Sans Pro', 'Lato', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #58585b

g.text: the solid line is their vertical average. The quoted AUC is the MEAN of the five per-fold AUCs ± 1 SD — the quantity validation_report.md pins

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', 'Source Sans Pro', 'Lato', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #58585b

g.text: — not the area under the averaged curve. Bars to the right of zero raise the predicted probability of holding debt; the 20 omitted
